march-on-washington.flavor: Half a million marched in the rain. The senators noticed and raised their umbrella budget.

market-manipulation.rules: Remove the Action tokens from any number of Bank Groups and, if you wish, from one Corporate Group. This is not an action.
market-manipulation.flavor: The market went up, then down, and somehow the same people got rich both times.

martial-law.rules: One Government Group you control gets +10 Power or Resistance. Boosting an action: play it as the action is announced; it lasts for that action. Defending: it lasts until end of turn and never counts for Goals.
martial-law.flavor: For your safety, curfew begins at six. For your convenience, the checkpoint serves coffee.

martyrs.rules: One Peaceful Group you control gets +10 Power or Resistance. Boosting an action: play it as the action is announced; it lasts for that action. Defending: it lasts until end of turn and never counts for Goals.
martyrs.flavor: The movement mourned them nobly, photographed the vigil beautifully and mailed fundraising letters by morning.

mass-murder.rules: Remove the Action tokens from any Media Groups in play you choose; any of them acting in the current attack have that action cancelled. Pay with your Illuminati's action, or Media Groups' actions totalling Power 5 or more.
mass-murder.flavor: The broadcast was interrupted, the newsroom went dark, and the ratings have never been better.

media-blitz.rules: Spend a Media Group's action while you hold a Group card duplicating a destroyed Group, not an Assassinated Personality. You may play it normally, as if never destroyed; the original stops counting as destroyed for Goals.
media-blitz.flavor: The comeback tour was announced before the funeral had finished.

media-connections.rules: The chosen Group gains the Media attribute, and its Global Power becomes equal to its Power. Link this to it. Pay with actions of Media Groups totalling Power 6 or more.
media-connections.flavor: He called in one favor. By dawn he had three talk shows and a documentary.

messiah.rules: Not during an attack. Link this to one of your Personalities: +4 Power and +4 Resistance, plus 2 more of each for every Church Group you control. Only 1 Messiah may be in play in the whole game.
messiah.flavor: He claimed he could walk on water, turned the claim into ratings and sold the rights.

meteor-strike.rules: Instant. Attack to Destroy any Place, of any size, at Power 16, no action needed. Success Devastates it; beating the roll by 5 or more destroys it.
meteor-strike.flavor: The observatory saw it coming for weeks but waited for a better press slot.

miracle-diet-plan.rules: Not during an attack. Spend a Media Group's action. One Science Group you control makes its next action at triple Power. Also, one rival Group, not an Illuminati, loses its Action tokens.
miracle-diet-plan.flavor: Lose weight while you sleep. Lose money while you are awake.

mistaken-identity.rules: During an attack. Play against any Assassination, whoever made it: it fails automatically.
mistaken-identity.flavor: The target was reported dead. The target has since been reported playing golf.

mob-influence.rules: Spend the action of a Criminal Group you control: its Power becomes 6. Link this to it. You may have only 1 Mob Influence in play.
mob-influence.flavor: The offer was made politely. The alternatives were described in detail.

monopoly.rules: Spend the action of a Corporate Group you control: its Power becomes 6. Link this to it. You may have only 1 Monopoly in play.
monopoly.flavor: Competition is healthy. That is why they bought all of it.

mother-s-march.rules: During an attack. Play right after an Attack to Destroy succeeds. The attacker rerolls at once at -4, and nobody may change the rerolled attack's strength. Costs the action of one of your Groups with Power 3 or more.
mother-s-march.flavor: They brought strollers, placards and a collective glare that could stop traffic.

murphy-s-law.rules: During an attack. Play right after the attack dice are rolled: the roll counts as a 12. Spend every Action token on your Illuminati (at least 1).
murphy-s-law.flavor: The toast landed butter side down, the dice landed high, and the backup plan was shredded.

mutual-betrayal.rules: Spend the action of one of your Groups and choose a rival. Look at all their hidden Plots. You may expose any number of them, but you must expose one of your own Plots for each.
mutual-betrayal.flavor: We trusted each other completely, which is why we both hired detectives.

nationalization.rules: The target Group becomes Government for good, losing Corporate. Pay with your Illuminati's action, or Government Groups' actions totalling Power at least its Resistance (x2 if Corporate), plus its position bonus if a rival controls it. Link to it.
nationalization.flavor: The factory now belongs to the people. The people are asked to stop touching it.

never-surrender.rules: Free move, any time, even while the target is under attack. Link this to a Fanatic Group of any player, or one a rival has just played from hand: its Resistance becomes 12.
never-surrender.flavor: They lost the war decades ago. Nobody has told them, and nobody wants to.

new-blood.rules: Spend the action of a Violent Group you control: its Power becomes 6. Link this to it. You may have only 1 New Blood in play.
new-blood.flavor: The old guard retired. The new guard brought bigger guns.

new-federal-budget.rules: Spend your Illuminati's action. Give an Action token to your Government Groups without one: any number totalling Power 5 or less, or any single Group. Groups captured this turn or barred from tokens cannot be chosen.
new-federal-budget.flavor: The budget was balanced by moving the deficit into a different spreadsheet.

nice-idea-it-s-mine-now.rules: Your turn only. Spend your Illuminati's action and take a rival's exposed Goal card. It stays exposed in front of you and is now your Goal.
nice-idea-it-s-mine-now.flavor: Imitation is flattering. Outright confiscation is far more efficient.

nobel-peace-prize.rules: Spend the action of a Peaceful Group you control: its Power becomes 6. Link this to it. You may have only 1 Nobel Peace Prize in play.
nobel-peace-prize.flavor: Awarded for peace, endowed by explosives, and polished by irony.

nuclear-accident.rules: Instant. Attack to Destroy any Place, no action needed, at Power 18 (Huge: 14). Success Devastates it; beating the roll by 5+ destroys it. Whenever this is played, the Nuclear Power Companies are left with no Action token.
nuclear-accident.flavor: The plant was perfectly safe right up until it glowed.

opportunity-knocks.rules: Counter. When a rival discards a Group they failed to take over from hand, attack it immediately, out of turn, to Control or Destroy at +5, using your current Action tokens and Plots. Others may aid. Then their turn resumes.
opportunity-knocks.flavor: A botched recruitment leaves an unaffiliated organisation on the doorstep. Somebody should take it in.

payoff.rules: Counter. Play when a rival plays a duplicate of a Group you control. The rival discards that duplicate.
payoff.flavor: Whatever they offered your people, you offered double. Loyalty is just a number nobody else thought to beat.

plague-of-demons.rules: Disaster. Either spend a Magic Group's action: Instant Attack to Destroy a non-Huge Place, Power 10 plus that Group's Power. Success Devastates it; by 6+, destroys it. Or discard: +10 to an Attack to Destroy a Magic Group.
plague-of-demons.flavor: Claim status: gas leak. Adjuster's note: the gas leak had horns.

pledge-drive.rules: Any time. Spend your Illuminati's action to give an Action token to your tokenless Liberal Groups: any one, or several with total Power 5 or less. Not Groups captured this turn or barred from receiving tokens.
pledge-drive.flavor: The tote bag is free. The obligation to march where you're pointed comes at no extra charge.

poison.rules: Assassination. Any time, no action needed: Instant Attack to Destroy any Personality at Power 8. One Criminal or Magic Group of yours may spend its action to add its Power. It counts as Magic only if a Magic Group joins.
poison.flavor: Coroner's footnote: cause of death, the canapés. Manner of death, the host.

power-corrupts.rules: Any time. Target Group becomes Criminal for good; link this card to it. Pay with your Illuminati's action, or Criminal Groups' actions totalling at least its Resistance, plus its closeness bonus if a rival controls it.
power-corrupts.flavor: Nobody sets out to be crooked. First a small favour, then a larger one, then the yacht.

power-grab.rules: Your turn only. Right after your automatic takeover, make one more automatic takeover of a Group or Resource. Your turn then ends at once: you still collect Action tokens, but take no further steps.
power-grab.flavor: Why build an empire one brick at a time when you can pocket two bricks and sprint?

privatization.rules: Any time. Target Group becomes Corporate for good, losing Government and any Dictatorship; link this card. Pay with your Illuminati's action, or Corporate Groups' actions totalling at least its Resistance (x2 if Government), plus closeness bonus if a rival's.
privatization.flavor: The ministry now has a mascot and a loyalty programme. Service has never cost more.

privileged-attack.rules: During an attack. Make your attack Privileged: only you and the target's owner, if any, may aid or oppose. Your Illuminati or a Secret Group of yours must join it or spend an Action token.
privileged-attack.flavor: This meeting is by invitation only. The invitations were never sent. The meeting has already ended.

pulitzer-prize.rules: Any time. A Media Group you control gets +10 Power or +10 Resistance. For an action, play it at declaration; it lasts for that action only. On defense, it lasts until end of turn and never counts toward Goals.
pulitzer-prize.flavor: The story was bold, meticulously sourced and entirely invented. The committee admired its courage.

purge.rules: Your turn only. Play as one Group's action. Illuminati: destroy every Agent in play that duplicates your Illuminati. Any other Group loses 1 Power and 1 Global Power, but rival duplicates no longer affect it; link this card to it.
purge.flavor: The loyalty review found three moles and one confused intern. All were reassigned to oblivion.

rain-of-frogs.rules: Disaster. No action needed: Instant Attack to Destroy any Place of any size at Power 10, plus 4 for each Frog God its owner has in play. Success Devastates it; success by 7+ destroys it outright.
rain-of-frogs.flavor: Forecast: scattered amphibians, heavy at times. Some arriving in formation.

reach-out.rules: Your turn only. At the end of your turn, spend your Illuminati's action. Remove every Action token from one rival's Power Structure, then from your own. Resources keep their tokens.
reach-out.flavor: A friendly call to check on their plans. By the time they hung up, they had forgotten them.

read-my-lips.rules: Counter. Play after an Attack to Control or Attack to Destroy against one of your Personalities succeeds. That attack fails instead. Useless against Assassinations.
read-my-lips.flavor: The promise was firm, sincere and televised. The reversal was scheduled for a slow news day.

red-scare.rules: Any time. Spend your Illuminati's action to give an Action token to your tokenless Conservative Groups: any one, or several with total Power 5 or less. Not Groups captured this turn or barred from receiving tokens.
red-scare.flavor: Under every bed, a subversive. Under every subversive, a funding opportunity for the vigilant.

reload.rules: Any time. Spend your Illuminati's action to give an Action token to your tokenless Violent Groups: any one, or several with total Power 5 or less. Not Groups captured this turn or barred from receiving tokens.
reload.flavor: Diplomacy failed at breakfast. By lunch, the negotiators had requested more ammunition.

reorganization.rules: Your turn only. Spend your Illuminati's action to rearrange your whole Power Structure as you like, moving your Groups to any legal positions.
reorganization.flavor: The new org chart is bold, agile and synergistic. Nobody knows who reports to whom, by design.

resistance-is-useless.rules: Any time. One of your Media Groups spends its action. Until end of turn, the target Group has Resistance 0, with no bonus from abilities or its master's alignments. Its +5/+10 for closeness to its Illuminati still applies.
resistance-is-useless.flavor: After three weeks of coverage, the board simply agreed it had always wanted to be acquired.

revolution.rules: During an attack. Play with any Attack to Control or Destroy on a Nation: +10, or +20 if it is a Dictatorship. A Group not taking part in the attack must spend its action.
revolution.flavor: The palace fell by noon. The new regime held a press conference by two, a parade by four.

rewriting-history.rules: Any time. Add, remove or reverse one alignment of a destroyed Group; this can change which destruction Goals it counts toward. Pay with your Illuminati's action, or Media Groups' actions totalling Power 8+.
rewriting-history.flavor: The archives have been updated for accuracy. The previous accuracy has been filed somewhere unreachable.

sabotage.rules: Counter. A rival's automatic takeover from hand fails: the Group returns to their hand and they get no more automatic takeovers this turn. Pay with your Illuminati's action, or Groups totalling Power 6+, one sharing an alignment with it.
sabotage.flavor: The keys were cut and the office furnished. Then someone swapped the address on the deed.

save-the-whales.rules: Any time. A Green Group you control gets +10 Power or +10 Resistance. For an action, play it at declaration; it lasts for that action only. On defense, it lasts until end of turn and never counts toward Goals.
save-the-whales.flavor: The whales were saved. So was the donor list, which was cross-referenced and quietly sold.

savings-loan-scam.rules: Any time. Spend any one of your Groups' actions. Discard this card and draw 3 cards from your Plot deck.
savings-loan-scam.flavor: Deposits were insured, loans were imaginary and the auditors were on a fact-finding cruise.

scandal.rules: Any time, but not during an attack. Spend the action of a Media Group with Power 2+. Choose a rival and one alignment that Media Group has: that rival's Groups with that alignment lose all Action tokens.
scandal.flavor: Sources close to the source confirm that sources have been confirmed. Resignations to follow.

secrets-man-was-not-meant-to-know.rules: Counter. Play right after any other Plot is played, for any purpose: cancel it and discard both cards. Pay by removing every Action token from your Illuminati (at least 1), or by discarding your top 2 Plot deck cards unseen.
secrets-man-was-not-meant-to-know.flavor: The manuscript explained everything. Its last reader now alphabetises his socks by feel.

seize-the-time.rules: At the start of a rival's turn, spend your Illuminati's action to take a special turn instead; then theirs resumes unless someone won. Only your Groups get Action tokens. No drawing, no Plots. Not in round 1; once per game.
seize-the-time.flavor: History waits for no one. You simply arranged for it to wait for everyone else.

self-esteem.rules: Any time. Use the action of one of your Liberal Groups to link this card to it. Its Power rises to 6 at once; a stronger Group keeps its Power. You may have only 1 Self Esteem in play.
self-esteem.flavor: After the weekend retreat, the committee stopped apologising and annexed the building next door.

senate-investigating-committee.rules: As another player's turn begins, spend a Power 5+ Government Group's action. That turn they may only draw cards and place Action tokens. Not against the Discordians. Once per game per target; a repeat fizzles and is discarded.
senate-investigating-committee.flavor: The hearings will continue until the witness remembers something or the cameras leave.

slush-fund.rules: Any time. A Conservative Group you control gets +10 Power or +10 Resistance. For an action, play it at declaration; it lasts for that action only. On defense, it lasts until end of turn and never counts toward Goals.
slush-fund.flavor: No receipts, no ledger, no questions. Just a very large envelope and a handshake that lingers.

sniper.rules: Assassination. Any time, no action needed: Instant Attack to Destroy any Personality at Power 10. One Government Group of yours may spend its action to join and add its Power.
sniper.flavor: Officially the rooftop was empty and the rifle was a telescope. No further comment.

spasm-of-violence.rules: During an attack. Play with one of your Assassinations plus a second Assassination card against the same target. Follow the main one's full text; the second adds only its Power, none of its other effects.
spasm-of-violence.flavor: One attempt is a tragedy. Two at once is a coordination problem someone gets promoted for.

stealing-the-plans.rules: Counter. Right after another player discards a Plot, used or unused, take it into your hand. Costs the action of one of your Groups with Power 3+.
stealing-the-plans.flavor: They spent months drafting the scheme. You spent five minutes with a photocopier and a borrowed badge.

stock-split.rules: Any time. A Corporate Group you control gets +10 Power or +10 Resistance. For an action, play it at declaration; it lasts for that action only. On defense, it lasts until end of turn and never counts toward Goals.
stock-split.flavor: Shareholders now own twice as many shares of exactly the same thing. They were thrilled.

straighten-up.rules: Any time. Target Group becomes Straight for good, losing Weird; link this card. Pay with your Illuminati's action, or Straight Groups' actions totalling at least its Resistance (x2 if Weird), plus closeness bonus if a rival's.
straighten-up.flavor: Three sessions of posture coaching and a sensible briefcase. The subject no longer recalls being interesting.

sucked-dry-and-cast-aside.rules: During an attack. When one of your Groups (not your Illuminati) attacks, aids or opposes, its Power is multiplied by 4 for that action. Afterward it is destroyed, but counts toward no one's Goals.
sucked-dry-and-cast-aside.flavor: The consultants extracted every last ounce of value, then billed the husk for their time.

sweeping-reforms.rules: Any time. Discard every New World Order in play. Pay with actions of Media Groups totalling Power 6+; other players' Media Groups may chip in if their owners agree.
sweeping-reforms.flavor: The old order is swept away, replaced by a new one with more committees and better branding.

sweepstakes-prize.rules: Any time. Link this to one of your Personalities. It gets +4 on every direct Attack to Control it makes. You may have only 1 Sweepstakes Prize in play.
sweepstakes-prize.flavor: You may already be a winner. You are definitely already on a list.

swiss-bank-account.rules: During an attack. When your Illuminati makes a direct attack, it gets +10 Power for that attack. Never applies to Global Power.
swiss-bank-account.flavor: Numbered, discreet and wonderfully forgetful, especially whenever the tax inspector calls.

talisman-of-ahrimanes.rules: Counter. After an Assassination is played, it fails automatically. Link this to the saved Personality: it gets +2 against later Attacks to Destroy, +10 against Assassinations. If it dies anyway, the Talisman goes too. Only 1 in play.
talisman-of-ahrimanes.flavor: Carved by a forgotten cult, rediscovered in a pawn shop between a saxophone and a bowling trophy.

tax-breaks.rules: Any time. Spend your Illuminati's action to give an Action token to your tokenless Corporate Groups: any one, or several with total Power 5 or less. Not Groups captured this turn or barred from receiving tokens.
tax-breaks.flavor: The loophole was drafted by the companies it benefits and praised by the lawmakers they fund.

terrorist-nuke.rules: Any time. A Violent Group you control gets +10 Power or +10 Resistance. For an action, play it at declaration; it lasts for that action only. On defense, it lasts until end of turn and never counts toward Goals.
terrorist-nuke.flavor: The device was small, crude and possibly fake. The uncertainty was worth more than the uranium.

the-auditor-from-hell.rules: Any time. Spend the action of the Network, a Computer Group or a Bank Group. Look at all of one rival's hidden Plots, then take one of them or expose them all.
the-auditor-from-hell.flavor: Every receipt since kindergarten. Every coffee. Every napkin. The auditor was thorough, and personally delighted.

the-big-score.rules: Any time. A Criminal Group you control gets +10 Power or +10 Resistance. For an action, play it at declaration; it lasts for that action only. On defense, it lasts until end of turn and never counts toward Goals.
the-big-score.flavor: One last job. It's always one last job. The pension plan here is remarkably flexible.

the-big-sellout.rules: Your turn only. Right after placing Action tokens, discard up to 10 Groups and Resources from your hand and the top of your Group deck. Each Group discarded gives 1 extra Action token to a different Group you control.
the-big-sellout.flavor: Everything must go: principles, allies, old friends. No refunds. Fire sale ends at dawn.

the-first-thing-we-do-let-s-kill-all-the.rules: During an attack. +20 to any Attack to Destroy the Lawyers. Whoever plays this must read a mock legal disclaimer aloud; it has no game effect.
the-first-thing-we-do-let-s-kill-all-the.flavor: Counsel advises that this card is purely hypothetical. Counsel has stopped returning calls.

the-internet-worm.rules: Any time. Choose a rival: the top 3 cards of their Plot deck are discarded unseen. Pay with your Illuminati's action, or Computer Groups' actions totalling Power 3+.
the-internet-worm.flavor: It began as a harmless experiment. By Tuesday every server on Earth subscribed to its newsletter.

the-oregon-crud.rules: Disaster. Any time, no action needed: Instant Attack to Destroy any non-Huge Place at Power 24. Success Devastates it; success by 10 or more destroys it outright.
the-oregon-crud.flavor: Scientists call it a fungal bloom. Residents stopped calling it anything after dark.

the-second-bullet.rules: During an attack. Right after your own Attack to Destroy fails its roll, your Groups that could have aided it and still hold Action tokens may spend them, adding their Power as needed to make it a success.
the-second-bullet.flavor: The inquiry ruled the first shot missed and the second a coincidence. The third was never discussed.

the-stars-are-right.rules: Your turn only. Spend your Illuminati's action, or actions of Magic Groups each with Power 4+, to put a Resource from your hand into play as an automatic takeover, with no roll.
the-stars-are-right.flavor: The alignment comes once in a hundred millennia. Luckily it fell on a quiet Thursday.

the-weak-link.rules: Any time, except during a Privileged attack. Destroy a rival's Artifact or Gadget Resource and discard it. Pay with your Illuminati's action, or Science, Magic or Computer Groups' actions totalling Power 6+.
the-weak-link.flavor: Every perfect machine has one bolt fitted by the cheapest subcontractor. You found him.

the-weird-turn-pro.rules: Any time. Use the action of one of your Weird Groups to link this card to it. Its Power rises to 4 at once; a stronger Group keeps its Power. Limit 1 in play per player.
the-weird-turn-pro.flavor: The support group became a startup. The startup became a movement. The movement now sells merch.

tidal-wave.rules: Disaster. No action needed: Instant Attack to Destroy a Coastal Place at Power 20 if it is Huge, 24 otherwise. Success Devastates it; success by 11+ destroys it outright.
tidal-wave.flavor: The resort promised ocean views from every room. The ocean took that literally.

time-warp.rules: Counter. Right after another player rolls a success, they must reroll and keep the new result, but they also draw a Group card.
time-warp.flavor: Déjà vu is the universe checking its work. Today it found an error in your favour.

tornado.rules: Disaster. No action needed: Instant Attack to Destroy a non-Huge Place at Power 12. Success Devastates it; success by 5+ destroys it outright.
tornado.flavor: Forecast: light winds. The station's weather van was later found two counties over.

unlucky-13.rules: At the very start of a rival's turn, spend the action of one of your Magic Groups. Until that turn ends, the rival cannot draw Plot cards for any reason.
unlucky-13.flavor: The elevator skipped a floor, the calendar skipped a day, and their luck skipped town.

unmasked.rules: Any time, not during an attack. Play with an Illuminati card from your hand: it replaces your Illuminati, with its own powers and Goal; discard the old one. Any Agents card you hold for the new Illuminati is lost.
unmasked.flavor: Behind the mask was another mask, and behind that a very long list of demands.

upheaval.rules: Any time, but not during an attack or on your first turn. Spend your Illuminati's action: every player, you included, discards one Group from their Power Structure. Discarded, not destroyed, so none counts toward victory.
upheaval.flavor: Everyone agreed something had to go. Everyone agreed it should be someone else's something.

volcano.rules: Disaster. No action needed: Instant Attack to Destroy a non-Huge Place at Power 18. Success Devastates it; success by 2+ destroys it outright.
volcano.flavor: The brochure called the mountain dormant. It was merely procrastinating.

volunteer-aid.rules: During an attack. When a Disaster strikes a Place, it gets +6 to defend. If it is still Devastated, it gets Relief automatically at the start of its owner's next turn. Costs no action.
volunteer-aid.flavor: The volunteers arrived with blankets, soup and a startling amount of branded merchandise.

voodoo-economics.rules: Your turn only. Right after placing Action tokens, spend your Illuminati's action to remove up to 10 top Plot deck cards from the game. Each gives 1 extra Action token to a different Group of yours. Once per game.
voodoo-economics.flavor: Wealth will trickle down any day now. The chart says so, read by candlelight.

vultures.rules: Counter. When a rival discards a Group they failed to take over from their hand, take that Group card from their discard pile into your hand.
vultures.flavor: They circle the halls of power, patient and well-fed, waiting for someone's ambitions to expire.

whispering-campaign.rules: During an attack. Spend one of your Media Groups' action: your Attack to Destroy gets +15 against a Personality, +10 against any other Group. Not with Assassinations or Disasters. A Personality destroyed this way can never return to play.
whispering-campaign.flavor: Nobody said anything, exactly. An eyebrow was raised at exactly the right dinner party.

withering-curse.rules: Assassination. Any time, no action needed: Instant Attack to Destroy any Personality at Power 10. One Magic Group of yours may spend its action to add its Power. The attack counts as Magic.
withering-curse.flavor: He felt fine at breakfast. By dinner, his portrait looked healthier than he did.

world-cup-victory.rules: Any time. A Nation Group you control gets +10 Power or +10 Resistance. For an action, play it at declaration; it lasts for that action only. On defense, it lasts until end of turn and never counts toward Goals.
world-cup-victory.flavor: The team won on penalties. The ruling party awarded itself a medal and a tax holiday.

angel-s-feather.rules: Link to a Peaceful Group. If that Group fails an Attack to Control, reroll it. If any attack on a Peaceful Group you control succeeds, reroll it. The reroll stands.
angel-s-feather.flavor: Lot 44: one feather, provenance celestial, recovered from a windowsill. Handle only with gloves.

ark-of-the-covenant.rules: On your turn, secretly note one of your Groups under this card. If it is destroyed, reveal it: its destroyer is destroyed too (an Illuminati's owner loses a Group of their choice instead), counting for your Goals. Then note another.
ark-of-the-covenant.flavor: Crate 9 of 9. Do not open. Do not touch. Do not ask about Gerald.

bigfoot.rules: Bigfoot has its own action: spend it to cancel an action taken by a Media Group. You also get +3 on every attempt to control a Green Group.
bigfoot.flavor: Exhibit 7: one plaster footprint, size 23, and an unsigned modelling release.

book-of-kells.rules: Choose one. Unlinked: your Illuminati gets +1 Power and +1 Global Power. Linked to a Magic Group: that Group may take 2 actions per turn, but neither may be an Attack to Destroy.
book-of-kells.flavor: Illuminated manuscript, gold leaf throughout. The marginal doodles appear to be troop movements.

center-for-weird-studies.rules: Once in each of your turns, discard a Plot to give a new Action token to one of your Groups or Resources that has already acted. A Group still can't add its Power to one attack twice.
center-for-weird-studies.flavor: Campus facility, founding date disputed. Departments: psychic houseplants, spontaneous combustion, unmarked vans.

clipper-chip.rules: Every Government Group in your Power Structure gets +2 Power, and you are wholly immune to the Phone Phreaks. If you ever control no Government Group, discard this. Limit 1 per player.
clipper-chip.flavor: Standard-issue listening device. Listens only to criminals, defined as whoever it is listening to.

crystal-skull.rules: Each time you draw a Plot, look at the top 3 cards of your Plot deck and keep the one you want. Put each of the others on the top or bottom of the deck before your next draw.
crystal-skull.flavor: Carved quartz, origin disputed. Gazes into the future with an air of mild disappointment.

cyborg-soldiers.rules: Link to a Violent Group: its Power is doubled. The Soldiers are lost along with that Group.
cyborg-soldiers.flavor: Half man, half machine, fully covered by an extended warranty nobody has ever claimed.

death-mask.rules: Link to a Magic Group. Once the dice have been rolled, it may spend its action to join the attack, provided it was eligible to join normally. If its Power changes the outcome, the new result applies.
death-mask.flavor: Plaster cast of a sorcerer who died laughing. Chuckles softly whenever somebody rolls badly.

earthquake-projector.rules: Has its own action, usable once per turn: add +2 to any Attack to Destroy a Place, or to any Disaster.
earthquake-projector.flavor: Patent pending. Liability pending. Tested once, on the building that housed the patent office.

eliza.rules: Link to the Network or a Computer Group: it gets 1 extra action per turn. If that extra action ever rolls 11 or 12, Eliza crashes: discard her and reveal all your hidden Plots. Limit 1 per Group.
eliza.flavor: Therapy software, version 1.0. Asks how that makes you feel, then forwards the answer.

flying-saucer.rules: Linked to a Personality: it gets +10 against Attacks to Destroy, Assassinations included, and the Saucer is captured or destroyed with it. Unlinked: once per turn, discard your top Plot deck card for an extra automatic Resource takeover.
flying-saucer.flavor: Recovered craft, one careful owner, low mileage. Tractor beam sold separately.

hallucinations.rules: Has its own action, usable once per turn: either cancel the action of any Personality, or add +3 to any attempt to destroy a Personality.
hallucinations.flavor: Evidence bag 12: one sugar cube, unlabelled. The cabinet meeting it attended is still under review.

hammer-of-thor.rules: Has its own action, usable once per turn: give +2 Power to any Government or Violent Group when it makes an attack, or when it defends against an Attack to Destroy.
hammer-of-thor.flavor: Only the worthy can lift it. The worthy turn out to be mostly defence contractors.

hidden-city.rules: While you control it, your Illuminati gets +2 Power and +2 Global Power. Any Disaster may target it: it defends as a non-Huge, non-Coastal Place of Power 10 and can never be Devastated. If destroyed, anyone may play another.
hidden-city.flavor: Not on any map. Not visible from orbit. The post still arrives on Tuesdays.

hitler-s-brain.rules: Each time you destroy a Group, choose: draw 1 extra Plot, or turn all your exposed Plots face down again. While you hold this Resource, you cannot take control of Peaceful Groups.
hitler-s-brain.flavor: Specimen jar, sealed and labelled DO NOT FEED. Still drafting speeches nobody asked for.

immortality-serum.rules: Link to a Personality you control, or seize one as it is played (even from a rival's hand) without rolling. It can never be killed, even with its Place, and gets +5 against normal Attacks to Destroy. Link survives capture.
immortality-serum.flavor: Batch 1 of 1. Side effects include eternal life, mild nausea and endless re-election campaigns.

loch-ness-monster.rules: Nessie has its own action. Spend it to cancel an action by a Coastal Place, to add +4 to an Attack to Destroy a Coastal Place, or to add +4 to a Disaster against one.
loch-ness-monster.flavor: Shy, ancient and fiercely litigious. Clear photographs are answered by her solicitors.

mercenaries.rules: Once per turn, the Mercenaries may spend their own action to add +4 to an Attack to Destroy or +1 to an Attack to Control.
mercenaries.flavor: Hired muscle, sold by the hour. No cheques, no refunds, no loyalty clause.

midas-mill.rules: Choose one. Unlinked: your Illuminati gets +2 Power and +2 Global Power. Or link the Mill to any Coastal Group: its Global Power becomes equal to its Power.
midas-mill.flavor: Grinds salt, gold and stock options. Off switch not located; shareholders forbid further searching.

necronomicon.rules: Link to a Magic or Violent Group: its Power is doubled. If it ever rolls 11 or 12, it is destroyed and this card stays, unlinked. The loss counts toward your victory only for a Servants of Cthulhu player.
necronomicon.flavor: Bound in something that was probably leather. Margin notes stop abruptly mid-sentence.

orbital-mind-control-lasers.rules: Any time except in a Privileged attack, spend the Lasers' action to add, remove or reverse one alignment of a Group in play. It lasts until the current player's turn ends.
orbital-mind-control-lasers.flavor: Coverage: the whole planet. Beam setting: gentle persuasion. Side effect: sudden enthusiasm for new policies.

perpetual-motion-machine.rules: Link to a Group. That Group receives 1 extra Action token at the start of every turn.
perpetual-motion-machine.flavor: Violates three laws of physics, two patents and one sternly worded university letter.

principia-discordia.rules: Count the Weird Groups you control, itself included: each Weird Group in your Power Structure adds that number to its Resistance. Five Weird Groups means +5 each.
principia-discordia.flavor: Holy text, first edition, written by accident. Every copy is misquoted, as intended.

rogue-boomer.rules: You get +5 on your Attacks to Control a Nation. Or, once, add +10 to your own attempt to destroy a Place, or to any Disaster; then discard it.
rogue-boomer.flavor: Missile submarine, crew of 140, owner of record unclear. Currently taking offers.

shroud-of-turin.rules: Each time you draw from your Plot or Group deck, first peek at its top card if you like. Reject it and take the bottom card, unseen, instead.
shroud-of-turin.flavor: Linen, provenance hotly disputed. The gift shop stocks it in three sizes.

soulburner.rules: If a rival captures a Group of yours: take 1 Plot from their deck, or reveal their hidden Plots. If a rival destroys one: take 2 Plots from their deck, or reveal their hidden Plots and choose one they discard.
soulburner.flavor: Engine runs on grievance. Output: an enemy's plans, served warm.

spear-of-longinus.rules: As often as you like, with no action: +1 to any player's Attack to Destroy or any Disaster, once per attack. An attack it helps counts as Magic, so defences against Magic may apply.
spear-of-longinus.flavor: Legend says its holder rules the world. Its current holder rules a regional storage unit.

suicide-squad.rules: Any time except in a Privileged attack, target a rival's Resource and roll one die. 1: the target is destroyed; the Squad survives. 2-5: both are destroyed. 6: only the Squad is. Destroyed cards are discarded.
suicide-squad.flavor: Personnel file: enthusiasm high, life-insurance premiums higher, return rate negligible.

the-bronze-head.rules: When a Group card you played from your hand fails its takeover, return it to your hand instead of discarding it.
the-bronze-head.flavor: Oracle, cast bronze. Answers every question truthfully, cryptically and, regrettably, in rhyme.

the-frog-god.rules: You may interfere on either side of a Privileged attack; other players still can't without special cards. It costs the Frog God's action, and each of your interfering Groups spends its action too.
the-frog-god.flavor: Idol, jade, one careful owner. Croaks in an ancient tongue, mostly about flies.

the-holy-grail.rules: Secretly note one Place under this card; it can't be changed. If an attack would destroy or Devastate that Place, reveal the note: the attack fails, and the Grail keeps guarding it. If that Place is captured, discard the Grail.
the-holy-grail.flavor: Sought for centuries. Found behind the breakfast cereal.

the-library-at-alexandria.rules: You get +5 on your attempts to take control of a Computer, Science or Magic Group.
the-library-at-alexandria.flavor: Never burned after all. Simply relocated, with a much stricter late-return policy.

warehouse-23.rules: When played, you may fetch an Artifact or Gadget from hand or deck: free automatic takeover. Resources may hide face down beneath it, unusable, unseen by rivals. Expose any time, permanently, to use at once. Hidden cards share its fate.
warehouse-23.flavor: Aisle 40, next to the ark, behind the thing we agreed never to open again.

weather-satellite.rules: It has 2 Action tokens but uses only 1 per attack. Spend one to give a Tornado, Hurricane or Rain of Frogs +10 or -4, or any other Attack to Destroy (Disasters included) on a non-Space Place +4 or -2.
weather-satellite.flavor: Forecasts accurate to the minute, since the forecaster also makes the weather.

xanadu.rules: Duplicates of your Groups add no bonus when played in attacks to control or destroy your Groups.
xanadu.flavor: Pleasure dome, sacred river, strict policy: no visitors, no photos, no copycats.

the-great-pyramid.rules: Each rival shows you the first Plot they draw each turn; no notes allowed. Tornadoes and Hurricanes cannot affect the Great Pyramid.
the-great-pyramid.flavor: Forty centuries on the job and still the best-kept filing system on Earth. Tours hourly, no flash.

pyramid-marketing-schemes.rules: This Group gets +1 Power and +2 Resistance for each Fanatic Group in your Power Structure.
pyramid-marketing-schemes.flavor: Recruit three friends and become a diamond director. Recruit none and become a cautionary tale.

trading-card-games.rules: Any time during your turn, you may discard this Group and put another Group from your hand in exactly its place in your Power Structure, with no roll.
trading-card-games.flavor: Collect them all, trade them all, then argue about the rules for a decade. Welcome to the club.

five-year-plan.rules: Freeze! Requires an Illuminati or Communist action. Until the end of the turn, no Communist Group may spend Action tokens except to defend, or cancel one right after it acts.
five-year-plan.flavor: Quotas got met on paper well before anything got met in reality.

teddy-kennedy.rules: His Liberal puppets are immune to Attacks to Control, and defend at +5 against Attacks to Destroy.
teddy-kennedy.flavor: Every scandal survived just adds another chapter to the legend.

a-brief-attack-of-conscience.rules: Zap! Requires an Illuminati action. Play on a rival Illuminati: they can no longer use Assassinations or Disasters. Stays until removed; any player may spend an Illuminati action to strip every Zap from one player.
a-brief-attack-of-conscience.flavor: The killer paused mid-contract, weighed the ethics, then finished the job anyway.

you-d-pay-to-know-what-you-really-think.rules: Not during an attack. Discard a puppet-free Group, not your Illuminati (uncontrolled area, in standard play); the top Group card replaces it, tokens kept. A Resource joins your Resources; an illegal Group is discarded and you draw a Plot.
you-d-pay-to-know-what-you-really-think.flavor: But that service isn't offered in this area today.

backmasquerade.rules: Link it permanently to a Magic Group, letting that Group's action clear a Zap from any Illuminati whenever spent. Only one may be in play; playing a new one removes the old.
backmasquerade.flavor: Play the record forward and the message sounds suspiciously like a subpoena.

more-slack.rules: Pay one Slack token: expose all your own Plot cards. Once per game, for each player.
more-slack.flavor: Wanting more is the whole doctrine, really.

strange-bedfellows.rules: At any time: reverse any or all alignments of a Group you control, for one action, or for the whole token-placement step if played then. Doesn't count for Goals.
strange-bedfellows.flavor: Allies today, strangers tomorrow, and nobody remembers whose idea it was.

secret-fistemple.rules: May only control Personalities, and each becomes SubGenius. It may pass its Action token to its master, or to a puppet that is SubGenius by its own printed card. It always shares its master's alignments.
secret-fistemple.flavor: The doorbell exists only for people who already know.

the-meek-shall-inherit.rules: Zap. Requires an Illuminati action. Played on a rival Illuminati: no Group in that Power Structure may take over Violent Groups. Stays until removed.
the-meek-shall-inherit.flavor: Softly-spoken types suddenly can't be bullied into anyone's army.

good-sex-for-mutants-dating-league.rules: Every rival of its controller takes -2 attacking to control any Weird Group in play, wherever it is.
good-sex-for-mutants-dating-league.flavor: Everyone here already has someone, technically.

rant.rules: Your turn only, after token placement: spend an open-armed Personality's action to take a Group or Resource from the uncontrolled area (hand, in a mixed game) into play with no roll, as its puppet. Your turn ends.
rant.flavor: Nonsense, delivered with total conviction, moves mountains.

drs-for-bob.rules: Adds its Power to any SubGenius Group's defense, a free move that costs no token.
drs-for-bob.flavor: Their diagnosis is always the same: more noise, less quiet.

the-thule-group.rules: Spend its action, anytime: discard Group cards from hand, adding their printed Power to any Power or Resistance total, Instants included, regardless of alignment. With Hitler's Brain linked, it cannot be captured or destroyed.
the-thule-group.flavor: Every discarded flunky still adds weight to somebody's grand total.

inherently-bogus.rules: Not during an attack. A Church of the SubGenius Illuminati holding no SubGenius Groups loses one Action token. Once per victim each turn.
inherently-bogus.flavor: Faith without members still somehow pays overhead.

family-values.rules: Zap! Requires an Illuminati action. Play on a rival Illuminati: no Group in their Power Structure may take over Weird Groups, except the Discordian Society. Stays until removed; an Illuminati action strips all Zaps from one player.
family-values.flavor: Every relative gets tolerated at dinner except the two actually causing problems.

yetis.rules: May attach to any open side of its master, arrow or not. Any Group with an open side may attack to control it.
yetis.flavor: Cryptid status hasn't stopped the union dues.

you-are-what-you-eat.rules: Right after your Group (not your Illuminati) destroys a Group: discard the attacker, counting as destroyed but not for Goals, and put the destroyed Group in its place. Its puppets may be rehung, discarded, or returned to hand.
you-are-what-you-eat.flavor: Absorb your enemy's strengths; digest their weaknesses at leisure.

lyndon-larouche.rules: While his controller has a Government Group or named party, his Power equals the highest printed Power among them. Each turn, a roll of 1-3 gives him no token. His alignments never count for Goals.
lyndon-larouche.flavor: Every conspiracy connects eventually, given enough index cards and free time.

drought.rules: Disaster! Attacks to Destroy a Huge Place, no action, not Instant: Power 24 against a Coastal Place, 28 otherwise. Coastal Places and Relief-capable Groups may help defend. Success Devastates it; beating the roll by 10+ destroys it.
drought.flavor: The reservoir forecast kept insisting things were improving, right up until they weren't.

waiting-period.rules: Paralysis on a Violent Group, costing an Illuminati action or Peaceful actions equal to its Resistance: it cannot act, use abilities or Resources, or gain puppets, and doesn't count for Goals. Freed by losing Violent or an action from its master or any Illuminati.
waiting-period.flavor: Every itchy trigger finger cools off exactly on schedule.

saucer-landing-strip.rules: Whenever you hold no Plot cards, trade its Action token for two Plots at any time.
saucer-landing-strip.flavor: Visitors always leave better connected than they arrived.

advanced-supersonic-aluminum-nazi-hell-c.rules: Helping wreck a rival's Group in a winning Attack to Destroy earns you an extra Plot draw.
advanced-supersonic-aluminum-nazi-hell-c.flavor: Straight from the hollow earth, still insisting the trains run on time.

x-day.rules: Discard all your Plot cards and draw as many new ones, four at most. Once per turn.
x-day.flavor: The date keeps moving; the panic never does.

tanstaafl.rules: Zap. Requires an Illuminati action. Played on a rival Illuminati: no Group in that Power Structure may take over Liberal Groups. Stays until removed.
tanstaafl.flavor: Turns out every free lunch had a hidden delivery fee.

copy-shops.rules: Spend its action, discard a Plot, and copy a rival's exposed, legally playable Plot at cost, leaving the original with them. It resolves now — a Goal only if it wins at once — keeping any link.
copy-shops.flavor: Every knockoff comes out remarkably close to the genuine article, allegedly.

pale-people-in-black.rules: When it takes part in an Attack to Control, the target's opposite-alignment penalty is ignored. It cannot be destroyed by any means.
pale-people-in-black.flavor: Nothing moves them: not victory, not despair, not last call.

end-of-the-world.rules: Yellow NWO. Church and Fanatic Groups get +2 Power, +3 if both; Corporate and Government Groups get -2 Power.
end-of-the-world.flavor: Every prophecy needs a sequel once the deadline quietly passes unnoticed.

convenience-stores.rules: Any agents card you play gets +5, attacking or defending. You may also give that +5 to another player's agents card, free. No effect on spare Illuminati agents. Gets +10 against Attacks to Destroy.
convenience-stores.flavor: Every checkout line doubles as a small, cheerful arms bazaar.

pinks.rules: Whenever they have no Action token, take one from another Straight Group you control.
pinks.flavor: Ambition, borrowed strictly from someone else's paycheck.

teflon-coating.rules: When a Personality is attacked and a rival's Media Group takes part: every Media action in that attack is cancelled, and no more Media Groups may join it.
teflon-coating.flavor: Every accusation slides right off, leaving the cameras confused.

give-me-slack-or-give-me-food.rules: Counter. Right after you play a Plot: discard this and one other card, and take that Plot back into your hand.
give-me-slack-or-give-me-food.flavor: Buyer's remorse, priced at exactly two cards.

false-slack.rules: Requires an Illuminati action. Strip every Action token from a rival's Group, other than their Illuminati, and from every puppet beneath it. Once per victim each turn.
false-slack.flavor: Their to-do list survives; their motivation does not.

time-control.rules: Your turn only: your Illuminati may launch one direct attack using its printed Power, at no token cost, and you may spend no other Illuminati tokens this turn except to buy Plots.
time-control.flavor: Every other minute of the day still runs late.

nevermore.rules: Right after a Plot resolves, ban it for the rest of the game, kept under this card. Once down, anyone may keep banning Plots, paid for with an Illuminati action, or by discarding two Plots from hand or deck.
nevermore.flavor: Once forbidden, a plot simply ceases to exist, at least on paper.

floating-point-error.rules: Freeze! Requires an Illuminati or Computer action. Until the end of the turn, no Computer Group may spend Action tokens except to defend, or cancel one right after it acts.
floating-point-error.flavor: The spreadsheet balanced perfectly, right up until the decimal quietly wandered off.

vile-secretions.rules: Paralysis on a Weird Group, costing an Illuminati action or Straight actions equal to its Resistance: it cannot act, use abilities or Resources, or gain puppets, and doesn't count for Goals. Freed by losing Weird, or an action from its master or any Illuminati.
vile-secretions.flavor: Every strange impulse gets minuted, filed, and quietly tabled.

black-helicopters.rules: Unique. Link for good to a Secret or Government Group: all its attacks become Privileged. Discarded once that Group is no longer Secret or Government.
black-helicopters.flavor: Rotor blades over the neighborhood always meant a very routine, unrelated inspection.

the-magic-goes-away.rules: Red NWO. Magic Resources do nothing and Magic Groups get -1 Power, still counting fully for Goals. Every Illuminati gets -1 Power, and nobody makes automatic takeovers.
the-magic-goes-away.flavor: Spells fizzle, wands go quiet, and accountants finally feel useful.

the-saint-of-sales.rules: Your turn only. Spend your Illuminati's action, or SubGenius actions totaling 4 Power: take one Resource from the uncontrolled area or your hand into play with no roll.
the-saint-of-sales.flavor: He could sell the flood insurance during the flood.

psychic-pstench.rules: Requires a SubGenius Personality's action. A rival shows all their Plot cards, or discards one exposed Goal.
psychic-pstench.flavor: Their intentions reek from three rooms away.

jhvh-1.rules: Requires an Illuminati action. A rival discards half their Plot cards, rounded up, choosing which.
jhvh-1.flavor: Somewhere a server logs every prayer you never sent.

day-care-centers.rules: Always has exactly its master's alignments; nothing else changes them. A Fanatic master's own Fanatic alignment still counts. When destroyed, it keeps whatever alignments it had at that moment.
day-care-centers.flavor: Naptime enforces itself; nobody negotiates with a toddler about anything, ever.

reverse-whammy.rules: When a rival plays a Zap on you, it hits them instead. Costs a Group card from hand or the top of your Group deck.
reverse-whammy.flavor: Boomerangs are traditional. Boomerangs also, on occasion, come back sharpened.

martyr-meter.rules: Unique. At token placement, one Personality you control gets an extra Action token. Its holder is immune to Random Jesii.
martyr-meter.flavor: Suffering, like everything else here, gets quantified.

population-reduction.rules: Goal. Each Huge Place you destroyed (up to 3) counts double toward your Basic Goal; no other destroyed Group counts. Or win outright with 5 Huge Places destroyed while World War III is absent.
population-reduction.flavor: Fewer mouths, fewer complaints, more room at the summit table.

don-t-touch-that-dial.rules: Requires a Media Group's action. Play when an attack on a Media Group fails: the attacker's turn ends immediately.
don-t-touch-that-dial.flavor: Nothing ends a hostile broadcast faster than a live equipment malfunction.

arise.rules: Goal. When a rival takes your last puppet, reveal this: you stay in until end of turn. If you still have none, you win. You may share this win with your own Illuminati's other player.
arise.flavor: Defeat becomes a technicality once you refuse to leave the table.

frop-farm.rules: Its action: strip every Action token from one Personality.
frop-farm.flavor: Harvested fresh, forgotten just as fresh.

interesting-times.rules: Blue NWO. Choose one: only the Basic Goal can win, blocking Special Goals and Goal cards, or the Basic Goal needs two more Groups.
interesting-times.flavor: Ordinary ambition suddenly needed extra paperwork nobody remembered signing up for.

cat-juggling.rules: Paralysis on a Peaceful Group: no tokens, ability, linked Resource use, new puppets or Goal credit, until it loses that alignment or its master or an Illuminati acts. Costs an Illuminati action, or Violent actions worth its Resistance.
cat-juggling.flavor: The talent agency swore the act was harmless, right up until the claws came out.

st-janor-hypercleats.rules: In attacks he makes or aids, an 11 doesn't auto-fail, but a natural 2 counts as 12 and costs your Illuminati a token if held. He may attack, or aid, Secret Groups of any alignment.
st-janor-hypercleats.flavor: His cleats have opinions about everyone's footwork.

back-to-the-salt-mines.rules: When a Place is attacked, not by an Instant attack, play for +10 to your side. One per attack. If the defender plays it, an attacker's copy returns to hand; if your side wins, it returns to your hand, exposed.
back-to-the-salt-mines.flavor: Shift change never really ends; someone's always due back underground by morning.

australian-rules.rules: Red NWO. Attacking a rival, or aiding the attack, earns an extra Plot draw; capturing or destroying a rival's Group earns an extra Group draw.
australian-rules.flavor: Contact sport rules apply to boardrooms too, apparently, and nobody's filing a complaint.

science-cannot-remove-the-terror-of-the-.rules: Goal. Control Church Groups and have destroyed Science or Church Groups matching one pair: 5 and 2, 4 and 3, 3 and 4, 2 and 5, or 1 and 6. Combines with no other Goal.
science-cannot-remove-the-terror-of-the-.flavor: Faith fills the gap right where the lab coats stop.

earth-first.rules: Goal. Win with destroyed Corporate Groups and controlled Green Groups totaling one of these pairs: 2 and 6, 3 and 5, 4 and 4, 5 and 3, 6 and 1. Combines with no other Goal.
earth-first.flavor: Chainsaws stalled just often enough that somebody started calling it sabotage.

brag-of-the-subgenius.rules: Goal. Each SubGenius Group of Power 3 or more you control counts as two Groups toward your Basic Goal.
brag-of-the-subgenius.flavor: Modesty was never really part of the Church's marketing plan.

blivit.rules: Spend its action to cancel another Resource's action while that Resource still holds its token. Its owner is safe from the Nuclear Power Companies. Only one may be in play; a new one destroys the old.
blivit.flavor: It hums, it whirs, nobody's ever confirmed what it's actually for.

bite-the-wax-tadpole.rules: Freeze! Requires an Illuminati or Media action. Until the end of the turn, no Media Group may spend Action tokens except to defend, or cancel one right after it acts.
bite-the-wax-tadpole.flavor: The jingle looped all afternoon until the outage mercifully cut the feed.

pizza-for-the-secret-meeting.rules: At any time: one Secret Group loses Secret status until the end of the turn.
pizza-for-the-secret-meeting.flavor: Deliverer sees everything, remembers nothing, and never gets a decent tip.

hubble-trouble.rules: Freeze! Requires an Illuminati, Space or Science action. Until this turn ends, Space and Science Groups, Satellites, and the Orbital Mind Control Lasers may act only in their own defense — or, following one of their moves, that move is undone.
hubble-trouble.flavor: The telescope photographs perfectly clear skies right up until launch day, every time.

sudden-european-vacation.rules: At any time: move a Personality you control to another master in any Power Structure. Hostile Plots just played on it, Instants included, are cancelled, and it is immune to hostile Plots for the rest of the turn.
sudden-european-vacation.flavor: Gone by morning, and somehow the paperwork clears itself instantly.

militia.rules: A win it makes or helps make in an Attack to Destroy adds 1 to its printed Power; a loss there takes 1 away, down to a floor of 1.
militia.flavor: Every drill photographs beautifully; every actual operation gets edited out entirely.

frankenfood.rules: Requires a Science action. Give a Place you control any alignment not opposite one it already has. Drop it whenever you like; a rival needs Science actions totaling 6 Power to remove it.
frankenfood.flavor: The tomatoes thrived in any climate, any soil, and most legal jurisdictions.

they-may-be-pink.rules: Whenever someone attacks a Straight Group, your Weird or SubGenius Groups are free to join its defense.
they-may-be-pink.flavor: Even the normal ones get backup sometimes.

watermelons.rules: Blue NWO. Green Groups count as Communist and Communist Groups as Green. Or link it to a Green or Communist Group of yours, making it both for good; it then counts as an ordinary Plot.
watermelons.flavor: Green outside, red inside, and the compost bin gets political.

bobbies.rules: When taken over, it hangs on any rival's open arrow, never counts for a Goal, and raises its owner's Basic Goal by one Group. Attacked successfully, it must be discarded or handed to a rival.
bobbies.flavor: Every arrest photo looks exactly like the one before it.

security-leak.rules: Zap. Requires an Illuminati action. Played on a rival Illuminati: every Plot they draw from then on is revealed as it is drawn. Stays until removed.
security-leak.flavor: Every card they draw might as well be read aloud.

enough-is-enough.rules: Your turn only, before drawing Plots: remove every Zap, Paralysis and Freeze from your Power Structure. You draw no Plot this turn.
enough-is-enough.flavor: Somebody finally said it out loud, and the meeting ended early for once.

janor-device.rules: Unique. Its holder may adjust any die roll they make by 1, up or down. Rolling a natural 11 or 12: if it's their turn, it ends at once; rivals then roll off, highest takes the Device.
janor-device.flavor: Fortune loves it more than it will ever love you.

overman.rules: Not during an attack. Link to a Personality in play, controlled or not, who isn't already a False OverMan: Power and Global Power become 3.
overman.flavor: Muscles first, wisdom optional, cape mandatory.

rain-of-prairie-squid.rules: Not during an attack. Shuffle the whole uncontrolled area into the Group deck and deal that many new cards there (in a mixed game, discard any number of your hand's Groups and draw as many).
rain-of-prairie-squid.flavor: Meteorology gave up explaining this years ago.

every-year-is-worse.rules: Paralysis on a Conservative Group: no tokens, ability, linked Resource use, new puppets or Goal credit, until it loses that alignment or its master or an Illuminati acts. Costs an Illuminati action, or Liberal actions worth its Resistance.
every-year-is-worse.flavor: Each new session promised reform, then quietly reused last year's exact language.

exorcism.rules: Remove every Zap from one player, yourself or a rival. Costs the top card of your Plot or Group deck, discarded unseen.
exorcism.flavor: The chanting worked eventually, mostly by boring the spirit into leaving.

smite-them-all.rules: Not during an attack; you need two or more Group cards in hand. Each rival sends one card from the uncontrolled area (their hand, in a mixed game) to the bottom of the Group deck, then you send two.
smite-them-all.flavor: Judgment Day runs on a strict rotation.

s-p-u-t-u-m.rules: Triple Power in any attack on a Personality.
s-p-u-t-u-m.flavor: It logs off only to go reload.

head-launching.rules: Link to a Group, spending its action and discarding two other Plots: its Global Power becomes equal to its printed Power.
head-launching.flavor: Communication improves dramatically once the head clears the atmosphere.

x-ray-specs.rules: Unique. Link to a Science Group: its action looks at the top three cards of one deck in play. A Weird Science Group may instead look at the top three of two decks, or the top six of one deck.
x-ray-specs.flavor: See straight through everyone's plans, except your own tailoring choices.

false-overman.rules: Not during an attack. Link to a Personality in play, controlled or not, who isn't already an OverMan: their Power becomes 3, and they gain Violent and Straight, losing Peaceful and Weird.
false-overman.flavor: Buy the cape, skip the whole transformation.

metric-system.rules: Paralysis on a Corporate Group: no tokens, ability, linked Resource use, new puppets or Goal credit, until it loses that alignment or its master or an Illuminati acts. Costs an Illuminati action, or Government actions worth its Resistance.
metric-system.flavor: Every measurement changed overnight; the invoices somehow stayed exactly the same.

subgenius-fistemples.rules: Every Group it controls, directly or through puppets, gets +5 Resistance.
subgenius-fistemples.flavor: Zoning laws have never once found them.

three-fisted-tales-of-bob.rules: Unique. Link to a SubGenius Place: it gets +2 Power, and Global Power equal to its new Power.
three-fisted-tales-of-bob.flavor: Every panel somehow ends with more questions.

orgone-grinder.rules: Unique. Link to a Personality you control: sets its Power to 6 and Resistance to 10, strips all alignments and attributes, and blocks any other card from adding new ones.
orgone-grinder.flavor: Charisma so total that opinions simply stop happening near him.

backfire.rules: Freeze! Requires an Illuminati or Magic action. Until the end of the turn, no Magic Group may spend Action tokens except to defend, or cancel one right after it acts.
backfire.flavor: Spells work exactly as intended, which is usually the whole problem.

school-prayer.rules: Freeze on Church, Liberal and Conservative Groups. Needs an Illuminati, Church, Liberal or Conservative action. None may spend Action tokens this turn except to defend. Or cancel a Church Group's action right after it happens.
school-prayer.flavor: Everyone bows their head; nobody agrees on why.

whistle-blowers.rules: Paralysis on a Government Group, costing an Illuminati action or Corporate actions equal to its Resistance: it cannot act, use abilities or Resources, or gain puppets, and doesn't count for Goals. Freed by losing Government or an action from its master or any Illuminati.
whistle-blowers.flavor: One leaked memo and the whole agency suddenly can't move.

anarchists-unite.rules: Zap! Requires an Illuminati action. Play on a rival Illuminati: no Group in their Power Structure may take over Government Groups. Stays until removed; any player may spend an Illuminati action to strip every Zap from one player.
anarchists-unite.flavor: No committee ever agreed on anything, which is precisely the point of the committee.

dokstok.rules: At token placement, its controller gets one extra token, which must first be given, traded to another player's Illuminati, or thrown away.
dokstok.flavor: Free tickets for everyone; the shuttle bus never actually shows.

glorps.rules: Their Power doubles when they attack, or help attack, to destroy a SubGenius Group; it triples once you've exposed The Anti"Bob".
glorps.flavor: Slime finds its own level, usually upward.

repent.rules: Right after your token placement: your turn ends at once and your Illuminati gains one more token.
repent.flavor: Guilt is optional; quitting early is not.

go-fish.rules: Name a Plot and a rival: they reveal hidden Plots, hand you every copy named, and discard two undrawn Plots each — or, lacking any, expose all your Plots instead. Recently targeted players are immune until their next turn ends.
go-fish.flavor: Everyone swears their hand is clean right up until the cards hit the table.

pave-the-earth.rules: Freeze on Green. Requires an Illuminati or Green action. Until the end of the turn no Green Group may spend Action tokens except to defend. Or cancel a Green Group's action right after it happens.
pave-the-earth.flavor: The rally ends early: nobody could find parking for the bulldozers.

let-the-sunshine-in.rules: Freeze! Requires an Illuminati or Secret action. Until the end of the turn, no Secret Group may spend Action tokens except to defend, or cancel one right after it acts.
let-the-sunshine-in.flavor: Every dossier gets aired eventually, usually at the worst possible moment.

the-13th-apostle.rules: Requires an Illuminati action. Give an Action token to one Personality, or to several totaling 5 Power or less. None may already hold a token or be barred from one.
the-13th-apostle.flavor: Nobody quite remembers electing him, exactly.

stark-fist-of-removal.rules: Your turn only. Your Illuminati keeps only one Action token, and a rival's Illuminati loses all of theirs. Your turn ends at once.
stark-fist-of-removal.flavor: Discipline arrives swinging and leaves no forwarding address.

dittoheads.rules: Only a Personality controls it, arrow or not, and never two. Its master gets +2 Power and triple Resistance. Unlimited copies may be in play, never an agents card; alignments are the master's plus Fanatic.
dittoheads.flavor: Every caller agreed completely, mega completely, with whatever aired moments earlier.

killer-satellite.rules: Cancels a Satellite Resource's or the Lasers' action. Discard it: a sure kill. Or roll: 1-3 kill target; 4 too, unless Lasers (then only this); 5 kills both; 6 only this. Or +5 attacking, or discard with token for +15 destroying, a Space Place.
killer-satellite.flavor: One well-placed nudge sends an orbital budget line back to committee.

mwowm.rules: Whenever any Plot is discarded, spend its action and roll a die: on 3 or less, you take that Plot.
mwowm.flavor: Nothing thrown away here stays thrown away.

antitrust-legislation.rules: Yellow NWO. Each player may reorganize: discard a Plot per Group moved, or 3 for a full reorg. A Corporate Group linked either way to another Corporate Group gets no Action token or ability use.
antitrust-legislation.flavor: Regulators drew up the paperwork, then let every lobbyist help edit it.

mediocretinism.rules: A Group loses SubGenius until the end of the turn.
mediocretinism.flavor: Genius is optional; mediocrity is mandatory today.

excremeditation.rules: Requires an Illuminati action. Give an Action token to one SubGenius Group, or to several totaling 5 Power or less. None may already hold a token or be barred from one.
excremeditation.flavor: Enlightenment arrives right on schedule, and so does everything else.

near-miss.rules: Play when a Place would be destroyed: it is only Devastated instead. Or remove Devastation from a Place. Two copies cannot fully cancel one destruction.
near-miss.flavor: The building survived intact; the insurance adjuster somehow looked personally disappointed.

dr-k-taden-legume.rules: While he is yours and SubGenius, no attack of any kind may be made on your other SubGenius Personalities.
dr-k-taden-legume.flavor: His sermons run long enough that assassins simply give up and leave.

visualize-whirled-peas.rules: Yellow NWO. Fanatic stops opposing Fanatic: every Fanatic Group now shares one identity. Any Fanatic Group without the Weird tag gains +2 Power.
visualize-whirled-peas.flavor: Rival zealots link arms and forget what they were shouting about.

blinded-by-science.rules: Goal. Win by controlling at least 6 Science Groups totaling 30 or more Power. Combines with no other Goal.
blinded-by-science.flavor: Peer review was thorough; funding renewal made it thoroughly unnecessary.

screaming-meme.rules: Link to an Organization, never an Illuminati: it cannot be taken or moved, and the Organization cannot be destroyed by any means. Only one may exist; a new copy discards the old.
screaming-meme.flavor: Once it gets stuck in your head, eviction is not an option.

sacred-stencil.rules: Unique. Against a rival's Attack to Destroy on any Group of yours, add +5 to your defense (in a mixed game, against Instant attacks too).
sacred-stencil.flavor: Sanctity, now available in spray-paint form.

bar-codes.rules: Requires a Computer Group's action. Look through a rival's Group deck for ten seconds without reordering or revealing it; the rival may then shuffle it.
bar-codes.flavor: Every purchase gets scanned twice; the second scan is just for curiosity.

crackdown-on-crime.rules: Paralysis on a Criminal Group: no tokens, ability, linked Resource use, new puppets or Goal credit, until it loses that alignment or its master or an Illuminati acts. Costs an Illuminati action, or Government actions worth its Resistance.
crackdown-on-crime.flavor: Photo ops multiplied while actual arrest numbers stayed remarkably, suspiciously flat.

truck-bomb.rules: Play when you attack to destroy an Organization, before anyone aids or opposes: it becomes an Instant attack, no action needed, made by one Violent Group with only your Illuminati helping, and no other bonuses.
truck-bomb.flavor: Subtlety was never really on the shopping list.

decency-is-ok.rules: Shuts down an action a rival's Weird Group either took or helped with.
decency-is-ok.flavor: Somewhere, someone claps politely and calls it entertainment.

shordurpersav.rules: Requires an Illuminati action, or two SubGenius actions. Right after you roll: roll again.
shordurpersav.flavor: Nobody agrees on the spelling, least of all its caster.

sultan-of-slack.rules: Not while a victory is contested. Until your next turn, nobody may win by their Illuminati's Special Goal unless they hold at least as many Action tokens as you. Once per game.
sultan-of-slack.flavor: Everyone else's Slack gets measured against his own.

random-jesii.rules: Not during an attack. Requires a SubGenius or Church action. A rival exposes all but one of their Plot cards, their choice. Not against the Martyr Meter's holder.
random-jesii.flavor: Pick a savior, any savior, they're all on sale.

church-of-middle-america.rules: A SubGenius Group anywhere above it in the Power Structure gains +2 Power, and +2 more to its Global Power total when it prints any.
church-of-middle-america.flavor: Every casserole recipe doubles as a loyalty oath.

go-lemmings-go.rules: When a rival discards cards from hand or deck to pay for a Plot or ability, they discard that many more of the same kind — two more if it was just one — from the same place, for no benefit.
go-lemmings-go.flavor: One tumbles, then several dozen colleagues follow with startling enthusiasm and zero hesitation.

general-disorder.rules: Spend his action for +10 to a Disaster, capped at Devastation. If removed, he returns at turn's end (unless someone's won) to his last master's open arrow or to hand, keeping linked Plots; puppets return to hand.
general-disorder.flavor: He keeps coming back to the meeting, no matter how firmly asked otherwise.

arms-dealers.rules: Spend its action, any time: trade any number of your Plots for as many of a rival's exposed Plots. Choose which received ones stay exposed; the rest are hidden. Given Plots keep prior state.
arms-dealers.flavor: Inventory rotates fast; today's embargo is tomorrow's closeout sale.

alien-abduction.rules: Play on a Personality: until end of turn it has no alignments and gains none. Or, outside an attack, spend a UFOs or Space Group action to move a Personality from hand or unclaimed into your Power Structure, no roll.
alien-abduction.flavor: The neighbors always figured the flying saucer story explained the sudden career change.

no-beer.rules: Disaster. Instant Attack to Destroy any Place. Power 16; 24 against Australia, Germany or Texas; 8 against France or Italy. The Liquor Companies may spend their action to halve or double it. Only Devastates, never destroys.
no-beer.flavor: Continents run dry, tempers run hot, treaties get renegotiated by furious mobs.

australia.rules: While controlled, its printed Resistance counts double — quadruple on weekends, local holidays or after 5pm. It gets +10 against Attacks to Destroy; the controller's other Organizations get +4 against Attacks to Destroy.
australia.flavor: Everything down under runs on schedules nobody outside the office ever sees.

reverend-ivan-stang.rules: At any time, he may give his Action token to another SubGenius Group with none.
reverend-ivan-stang.flavor: He keeps everyone else's schedule, never his own.

may-day.rules: Requires an Illuminati action, any time: give an Action token to one Communist Group, or to several Communist Groups totaling 5 Power or less. Not for Groups already holding a token or barred from tokens.
may-day.flavor: The parade route somehow passes every factory that's behind on its quota.

illuminati-university.rules: Each turn's end, discard a Plot or Group from hand or deck top, or discard it and return its puppets to hand. It, its master and puppets are immune to Disasters, Straight and Government Groups.
illuminati-university.flavor: Tuition comes due every semester, payable strictly in secrets, never in cash.

my-karma-ran-over-your-dogma.rules: Zap! Requires an Illuminati action. Play on a rival Illuminati: no Group in their Power Structure may take over Straight Groups. Stays until removed; any player may spend an Illuminati action to strip every Zap from one player.
my-karma-ran-over-your-dogma.flavor: Whatever goes around eventually comes back around, usually wearing a name tag.

lenin-s-body.rules: Unique. Link to any Group for +5 on its direct Attacks to Control Communist Groups. A Communist Group linked to it has Global Power equal to its Power.
lenin-s-body.flavor: The exhibit stays remarkably well-preserved, drawing crowds long after the ideology retired.

citizens-for-normalcy.rules: Immune to direct control attacks, automatic takeover, or being moved under the Church of the SubGenius, Discordian Society, or a Weird or SubGenius Group. Spend its token plus an Illuminati token: cancel any Plot.
citizens-for-normalcy.flavor: Even the weirdest cults agree: leave the normal ones alone.

partition.rules: On your turn, with a Huge Place in play: bring a duplicate from hand by automatic takeover, or by attacking to control it. It splits into two non-Huge Places at half Power (rounded up), +10 attacking each other. Reunite once you hold both.
partition.flavor: Two capitals, one grudge, and a border nobody agreed to draw.

church-of-violentology.rules: Destroying it earns each attacker's controller a Plot. If the attack fails, its controller draws a Plot per attacker, and the weakest attacking Group — never an Illuminati, random on ties — is destroyed, credited to it.
church-of-violentology.flavor: Membership dues cover the pews, the pamphlets, and remarkably the ammunition.

epa.rules: While it holds a token, the Nuclear Power Companies lose access to their special ability.
epa.flavor: Every permit gets stamped eventually, usually well after the spill dries up.

junk-bonds.rules: Freeze! Requires an Illuminati or Bank action. Until the end of the turn, no Bank Group may spend Action tokens except to defend, or cancel one right after it acts.
junk-bonds.flavor: The rating stayed triple-A right up until the vault turned out empty.

dallas-catacombs.rules: Your Groups may hang or switch to any side of their master anytime, arrows or not, but never more puppets than outgoing arrows. Lose the Catacombs and it all moves back onto real arrows; the overflow is discarded.
dallas-catacombs.flavor: No map survives long enough to reach the far end.

vladimir-zhirinovsky.rules: +10 on his direct attempts to control Russia; +5 on his direct attempts to control any other Communist Group.
vladimir-zhirinovsky.flavor: His threats get wilder every year; the polling numbers barely move.

overman-philo-drummond.rules: His Weird puppets are SubGenius. The OverMan and False OverMan Plots cannot affect him.
overman-philo-drummond.flavor: He already outgrew that ridiculous costume.

the-prescriptures.rules: Unique. Once each of your turns, spend your Illuminati's action, or the actions of all your Personalities (at least one): look at the top three cards of two decks, or a rival's Plots.
the-prescriptures.flavor: Every prophecy checks out, after the fact.

shock-jocks.rules: Leading an Attack to Control a Straight Group, it fights as Straight instead of Weird. It and its controller can step into either side of any fight touching a Straight Group.
shock-jocks.flavor: Outrage is the format; ratings are the religion; everyone tunes back in.

this-was-only-a-test.rules: When a rival announces a Disaster: it is stopped, returned to their hand exposed, and unusable until the end of their next turn.
this-was-only-a-test.flavor: The alarm was real; the emergency, mercifully, was not.

fake-healing.rules: Your turn only. Pick a Group in the uncontrolled area or your hand: its Resistance drops to 0 until the turn ends.
fake-healing.flavor: The cure works every single time nobody checks twice.

s-c-a-m.rules: Requires a Personality's action. Right after a rival makes any die roll: void it, and roll again.
s-c-a-m.flavor: Every con needs a second opinion, preferably rigged.

xists.rules: Cannot really be controlled. When destroyed, it goes to the uncontrolled area (its destroyer's hand, in a mixed game) instead of the discard pile, and never counts as destroyed for other cards.
xists.flavor: Nobody has ever actually seen one leave.

swingers.rules: Gets +1 Power for every other Liberal Group you control.
swingers.flavor: Monogamy was tried once; the turnout was disappointing.

comet-hail-bob.rules: Right after a rival brings a Group into their Power Structure from hand or the uncontrolled area, however they managed it: it is destroyed, not counting for any Goal. Costs an Illuminati action, or two Church Group actions. Once per player per game.
comet-hail-bob.flavor: The sign in the sky was clear; the RSVP was not optional.

society-of-assassins.rules: Each Fanatic Group you control has Global Power equal to its Power. Whenever one squares off in combat against a rival's Fanatic Group, you may make the two share one Fanatic alignment for that fight instead of opposing. Defending an Attack to Control, a Fanatic Group may instead share its master's Fanatic alignment.
society-of-assassins.goal: Special Goal: each Secret Group you control counts as two Groups toward your Basic Goal, unless a rival controls a stronger Secret Group.
society-of-assassins.flavor: Everyone converts eventually; the paperwork just takes longer for some.

contract-on-america.rules: Paralysis on a Liberal Group: no tokens, ability, linked Resource use, new puppets or Goal credit, until it loses that alignment or its master or an Illuminati acts. Costs an Illuminati action, or Conservative actions worth its Resistance.
contract-on-america.flavor: Every promise got signed, framed, and quietly filed under someone else's budget.

al-amarja.rules: Its controller ignores the I Lied card. When a Disaster hits Al Amarja, its controller or a puppet, the controller may discard undrawn Plots before the roll for +4 defense each.
al-amarja.flavor: Nobody remembers arriving; nobody plans on leaving; the paperwork insists otherwise.

the-green-party.rules: Fighting to seize another Green Group, add +4. Every other Green Group you already hold gains +1 Power.
the-green-party.flavor: Membership drives triple whenever a species makes the news.

tape-runs-out.rules: Requires an Illuminati action, or discarding three other Plots. Right after any Plot is played: cancel it, and discard both cards.
tape-runs-out.flavor: The revelation always cuts off at the good part.
