kill-bob.rules: During an Attack to Destroy a SubGenius Group, right after the roll: if it succeeds, everyone attacking gets an Illuminati token. If the target was yours, you get one regardless. Once per turn.
kill-bob.flavor: Martyrdom pays dividends whichever way the dice land.

bait-and-switch.rules: Zap! Requires an Illuminati action. Play on a rival Illuminati: no Group in their Power Structure may take over Corporate Groups. Stays until removed; any player may spend an Illuminati action to strip every Zap from one player.
bait-and-switch.flavor: The listed price vanished the instant anyone actually tried to pay it.

science-alarmists.rules: As long as you hold them, a rival needs your consent before automatically seizing a Science or Green Group.
science-alarmists.flavor: Every study ends the same way: send money, panic responsibly.

grave-robbers.rules: Whenever you may take over a Resource, search your Group deck for 30 seconds for an Artifact and put it into play with all its tokens. A Magic Artifact instead needs Magic actions totaling 6 Power.
grave-robbers.flavor: The shovel work is unglamorous, but the estate sale afterward pays remarkably well.

the-big-prawn.rules: Unique. Link for good to a Coastal Place: doubles its Power. As you link it, add, remove or reverse one alignment for good. Destroying the Prawn Devastates the Place; the Prawn is destroyed if the Place is destroyed or Devastated.
the-big-prawn.flavor: Tourists photograph a giant crustacean and never ask why the tide is angry.

lab-explosion.rules: Zap! Requires an Illuminati action. Play on a rival Illuminati: they can take over no more Resources. Stays until removed; any player may spend an Illuminati action to strip every Zap from one player.
lab-explosion.flavor: The safety inspection was thorough right up until the actual incident occurred.

phlegm-elementals.rules: When they join an attack, once the dice are rolled the target skips its next token placement.
phlegm-elementals.flavor: They leave a residue nobody wants to name.

supreme-court-nomination.rules: Attack to Destroy any Personality, no action needed, Power 15, never Instant or Privileged. Anyone may aid either side, Republicans, Democrats and Media double. Success destroys, not kills; failure makes the target Chief Justice, Power 4, Government not Corporate, unique.
supreme-court-nomination.flavor: One seat, one robe, and suddenly everybody loves the Constitution again.

lama-ramadingdong.rules: Counts +1 Power per additional Green Group sharing the board, and may leap into defense of a Green Group anytime, spending no action.
lama-ramadingdong.flavor: Every rally gets a little louder once the whole choir shows up.

death-to-all-fanatics.rules: Paralysis on a Fanatic Group: no tokens, ability, linked Resource use, new puppets or Goal credit, until it loses that alignment or its master or an Illuminati acts. Costs an Illuminati action, or Fanatic actions worth its Resistance.
death-to-all-fanatics.flavor: Zealots make excellent recruiters against rival zealots, oddly enough, every time.

oil-spill.rules: Disaster. Instant Attack to Destroy a Coastal Place: Power 14 vs Huge, 18 otherwise. Success Devastates; margin over 6 destroys it, giving every Green Group an extra token, once per player. Or +10 vs OPEC or the Multinational Oil Companies.
oil-spill.flavor: Cleanup costs less than the ad campaign about how sorry everyone is.

nhgh.rules: Cannot be destroyed; only a player who exposed The Anti"Bob" may control it. Uncontrolled, its 5 Power aids Attacks to Destroy; or play it as a +5 Plot on one, whose controller takes it.
nhgh.flavor: It answers to nothing, especially its own name.

devival.rules: Give +10 Power or Resistance to a SubGenius Group you control. With an action: play it when declared, for that action only. On defense: lasts until the end of the turn, not for Goals. One per action or defense.
devival.flavor: Converts stumble out changed, mostly by the free snacks.

church-of-the-subgenius.rules: Keeps its Action tokens from turn to turn as Slack, spending only one per action. It and your SubGenius Groups get +2 on direct Attacks to Control SubGenius Groups.
church-of-the-subgenius.goal: Special Goal: as many as 3 Slack tokens sitting on this card stand in for Groups toward your Basic Goal, and no other Goal may ride alongside it.
church-of-the-subgenius.flavor: Ordination is instant; enlightenment, as always, remains on backorder.

miraculous-manifestation.rules: Every player draws a Group into the uncontrolled area (in a mixed game, into hand, shown to you).
miraculous-manifestation.flavor: Prophecy appears wherever people are already staring.

speakers-in-tongues.rules: +3 on any attempt to control a Church Group.
speakers-in-tongues.flavor: Translation services are extra, and unreliable.

attitude-mutation.rules: At any time: add, remove or reverse one alignment of a Group you control, until the end of the turn. Free for a Group your Illuminati controls directly; otherwise it costs its master's action. One per turn.
attitude-mutation.flavor: Yesterday's dogma becomes today's punchline becomes tomorrow's dogma again.

www-subgenius-com.rules: At the start of each of your turns, draw an extra Group into the uncontrolled area (in a mixed game, spend its action any time to draw one).
www-subgenius-com.flavor: Pop-ups promised salvation; most delivered spyware.

divine-mail-order.rules: Its action alone nets a Plot; paired with an Illuminati action, it nets three instead.
divine-mail-order.flavor: Every catalog promises salvation; shipping and handling are extra.

sufficiently-advanced-technology.rules: Bond it to a Science Group of yours: Magic applies too, for as long as Science stays true. Bond it instead to a Magic Group, and Science follows the same way while Magic holds.
sufficiently-advanced-technology.flavor: Nobody can tell the ritual from the reboot anymore.

connie-dobbs.rules: As long as she carries both Straight and SubGenius, destruction cannot touch her or anything beneath her.
connie-dobbs.flavor: Every appliance in her house works flawlessly, out of sheer respect.

witch-hunt.rules: Illuminati action, at any time: give an Action token to one Church Group, or several whose Power totals 5 or less. Not for a Group already holding a token or barred from getting one.
witch-hunt.flavor: The accusation writes itself; the trial is mostly theater.

official-all-inclusive-divine-excuse.rules: Before the roll, when a Personality is attacked: the attack fails.
official-all-inclusive-divine-excuse.flavor: Every excuse arrives pre-approved, notarized, and free.

corrective-phrenologists.rules: Fighting alongside or against a rival's Violent Group, the moment dice land they gain a fresh Action token.
corrective-phrenologists.flavor: Every skull bump gets measured, mapped, and cheerfully misdiagnosed.

sorry-wrong-number.rules: Zap. Requires an Illuminati action. Played on a rival Illuminati: their Power Structure loses its defense bonus for closeness to the Illuminati. Stays until removed.
sorry-wrong-number.flavor: Being near the top stops meaning anything, defensively speaking.

the-hour-of-slack.rules: Whenever a rival attacks a Group in your Power Structure, draw a Plot.
the-hour-of-slack.flavor: Reception is spotty; enlightenment airs anyway.

fickle-finger-of-fate.rules: Zap! Requires an Illuminati action. Play on a rival Illuminati: they lose the takeover but, once a turn, may add +10 when their Illuminati leads an attack. Not in two-player games. Stays until removed; an Illuminati action strips all Zaps from one player.
fickle-finger-of-fate.flavor: Luck favored the house right up until someone actually started counting cards.

dobbstown.rules: Adds +5 whenever someone tries to seize a SubGenius Personality.
dobbstown.flavor: Paradise has a gate, a guard, and a strict dress code.

13013.rules: At any time: link to a SubGenius Group you control, raising its Power to 6. Counts as that Group's action. Only one may be in play per player.
13013.flavor: Stare at the number long enough and the rent still isn't paid.

bulldada.rules: Right after any die roll: that roll becomes a 12. Costs three other Plot discards.
bulldada.flavor: Nonsense wins arguments nobody was actually having in the first place.

spy-satellite.rules: Its action, at any time: look at three random Groups from a rival's hand, show them if you wish, then return them. Or expose one random Plot from a rival's hand instead.
spy-satellite.flavor: Whatever's up there sees everything and mostly finds it boring.

chain-letter.rules: Paralysis on a Straight Group: no tokens, ability, linked Resource use, new puppets or Goal credit, until it loses that alignment or its master or an Illuminati acts. Costs an Illuminati action, or Weird actions worth its Resistance.
chain-letter.flavor: Break the sequence and expect seven years of extremely specific bad luck.

rogue-subgenii.rules: Whenever they have no Action token, discard a Plot to give them one. Once per turn.
rogue-subgenii.flavor: Loyalty is negotiable; the getaway car isn't.

drug-companies.rules: May attack any Group in play as an Attack to Control, at +10. If it succeeds, the target permanently loses one alignment, attacker's choice.
drug-companies.flavor: One bad side effect birthed an entirely new, more profitable disease category.

s-l-a-k.rules: Gets an Action token at each rival's token placement, if it has none.
s-l-a-k.flavor: It never sleeps, mostly because it's furious.

cease-fire.rules: When two or more players are Zapped, remove every Zap in play. Costs the top card of your Plot or Group deck, discarded unseen.
cease-fire.flavor: Both sides agreed to stop, mostly because reloading had gotten expensive.

sacred-jests.rules: A rival picks one of their Plot cards at random: they must play it at once, or discard it. A Goal picked is shown instead.
sacred-jests.flavor: Comedy works best when nobody consented to the punchline.

don-t-rock-the-boat.rules: Zap! Requires an Illuminati action. Play on a rival Illuminati: no Group in their Power Structure may take over Fanatic Groups. Stays until removed; any player may spend an Illuminati action to strip every Zap from one player.
don-t-rock-the-boat.flavor: Every congregation stayed remarkably calm right up until the collection plate emptied.

regi-tered-trademark.rules: Link for good to a Group. Everyone must use its full printed name; a slip costs a Plot, from hand or deck. If the controller slips and a rival catches it, the controller hands over their top Plot.
regi-tered-trademark.flavor: Say it wrong twice and the lawyers start returning your calls.

anything-worth-doing-is-worth-overdoing.rules: Zap! Requires an Illuminati action. Play on a rival Illuminati: no Group in their Power Structure may take over Conservative Groups. Stays until removed; any player may spend an Illuminati action to strip every Zap from one player.
anything-worth-doing-is-worth-overdoing.flavor: One more escalation always seemed reasonable, and then there were several more.

the-true-pipe.rules: Unique. Your Illuminati gets +2 Power and +2 Global Power. Does not stack with another Resource that raises your Illuminati's Power.
the-true-pipe.flavor: It smokes back, occasionally, and always wins the argument.

spontaneous-combustion.rules: Assassination. Instant Attack to kill any Personality, no action needed. Power 10, 15 against a Magic Personality. One Magic Group may spend its action to add its own Power.
spontaneous-combustion.flavor: No arsonist, no motive, just an unlucky arrangement of static electricity.

the-irish-flu.rules: Put on a Personality: it loses this turn's Action token. Killing it cures the Flu; otherwise it grows immune next turn and passes to a Personality not yet immune. Discarded once nobody can catch it. Center for Disease Control shields its Power Structure.
the-irish-flu.flavor: Every immune survivor still avoids Personality parties for years afterward.

nental-ife.rules: Link to a SubGenius Personality, spending their action: their Global Power becomes equal to their printed Power.
nental-ife.flavor: Most of it just sits there, unbothered.

or-kill-me.rules: When your Illuminati holds no Slack, pick a rival who does: they give your Illuminati one token, or discard a Group from their Power Structure. For the rest of the turn you may only defend.
or-kill-me.flavor: Negotiation, SubGenius style: threaten yourself first.

robo-bob.rules: Your turn only, using its action: link permanently to a SubGenius Place you control. Nobody else may ever control it, and it gets +5 against any attempt to destroy it. One per player.
robo-bob.flavor: Its patience outlasts every prayer aimed at it.

dolphins.rules: Requires an Illuminati action, any time: give an Action token to one Green Group, or to several Green Groups totaling 5 Power or less. Not for Groups already holding a token or barred from tokens.
dolphins.flavor: Nobody asks how the pod always knows exactly where the yacht anchors.

defection.rules: Requires a Nation's action. Search your Group deck for a non-Unique Gadget, or a Clipper Chip, that copies a Resource a rival controls, and put it into play with all its tokens.
defection.flavor: Loyalty transfers overnight once the other side's budget looks more attractive.

supernova.rules: On your turn: for each Space action you spend (up to two), take a Gadget Resource into play at once. A Resource with actions arrives with all its tokens.
supernova.flavor: The sky lights up and every budget committee suddenly finds funding.

apathy.rules: Red NWO. No Group may lend support to another Group's attack.
apathy.flavor: Everyone stood by, arms folded, applauding from a safe distance.

beach-party.rules: Any time: give a Devastated Coastal Place Relief and an Action token at once. Stays linked to that Place, adding +5 against later Disasters.
beach-party.flavor: Nothing rebuilds morale like free drinks handed out on the rubble.

cast-out-false-prophets.rules: Eliminate a same-Illuminati rival by taking their last Group. Or play as a regular Plot instead: +10 wrecking the False Prophets, one of their puppets, or their master, unless the Illuminati holds them directly.
cast-out-false-prophets.flavor: Heresy is just orthodoxy that forgot to check in first.

schizm.rules: Declared with a non-Instant attack on a rival's Group: +10, overriding any immunity to control or destruction. On success, the target and its puppets go uncontrolled instead of captured or destroyed (mixed game: target discarded, puppets to owners' hands).
schizm.flavor: Every congregation eventually forks over the smallest slight.

crusade.rules: Gives a Church Group you control +10 Power or Resistance. Played with an action, when declared, it lasts for that action only. Played on defense, it lasts until end of turn, for defense only, and never counts for Goals.
crusade.flavor: The banners cost more than the actual campaign, but morale needed banners.

recycling-centers.rules: Spend its action, at any time: return a Group or Gadget Resource discarded this turn to its owner's hand. Whoever claims a discard first gets it.
recycling-centers.flavor: One player's cast-off conspiracy is another's Tuesday afternoon pickup.

jesus-b.rules: Once per game while you control him: mail a real dollar to the SubGenius Foundation for one Slack token.
jesus-b.flavor: Postage included, salvation sold quite separately.

eternal-salvation-or-triple-your-money-b.rules: Requires a SubGenius Group's action. Once per game: draw Plot cards until you hold five.
eternal-salvation-or-triple-your-money-b.flavor: Refunds are processed the instant the world fails to end.

state-lotteries.rules: Spend its action, at any time: shuffle all your Group cards or all your Plots in hand back into that deck, then draw one fewer.
state-lotteries.flavor: The odds are terrible and the state prints them anyway, cheerfully.

local-clenches.rules: Its master gets an extra Action token each turn while it is SubGenius.
local-clenches.flavor: Every chapter meets, mostly to argue about snacks.

secret-master.rules: Link to a Personality your Illuminati controls directly. It can never be captured, and can be destroyed only by an Assassination or another Illuminati's direct attack, at +20 against Assassination. It loses all alignments and attributes.
secret-master.flavor: Nobody elected them, nobody photographs them, everybody somehow obeys them.

back-to-the-drawing-board.rules: Zap! Requires an Illuminati action. Play on a rival Illuminati: whenever they would draw a Group card, they draw a Plot card instead. Stays until removed; any player may spend an Illuminati action to strip every Zap from one player.
back-to-the-drawing-board.flavor: Every want-ad promised a fresh hire; every envelope held another eviction notice.

league-for-obvious-decency.rules: Its action lets you send up to two exposed Plot cards back atop their owners' Plot decks.
league-for-obvious-decency.flavor: Modesty, they insist, starts with everyone else.

global-warming.rules: Blue NWO. Coastal Places get -2 Power, never below 1. Every other Place except Space Places becomes Coastal. Green Groups get +2 Power.
global-warming.flavor: The coastline moved inland this year, and real estate followed enthusiastically.

anti-slack.rules: At any time, on a rival whose Illuminati holds two or more Action tokens: remove one. Only one such strike lands on any single player each turn.
anti-slack.flavor: Nothing kills momentum like a well-timed guilt trip.

the-anti-bob.rules: Goal. Control 6+ SubGenius Groups and have destroyed 2+ rivals' SubGenius or Weird Groups. Expose it yourself once for one extra Illuminati token; it then can never be hidden or discarded.
the-anti-bob.flavor: Nobody elected him, and nobody can unelect him either.

false-prophets.rules: Add +4 when you attack a rival's Church Group, to control or destroy it.
false-prophets.flavor: Every scripture they sell comes bundled with a coupon.

nutrition-nazis.rules: Any Science Group may join either side of an attack involving them, regardless of alignment. Once per game, play from hand as a Plot instead: link it to a Group, which becomes Science for good.
nutrition-nazis.flavor: They weigh your lunch, judge your soul, and bill the insurance twice.

newt-gingrich.rules: While he is in any Power Structure, every Attack to Destroy a Liberal Group gets +3. His own direct attacks to destroy Liberal Groups get +5 more.
newt-gingrich.flavor: Every proposal comes wrapped in a grand historical analogy, usually inaccurate.

power-satellite.rules: Link to a Space Place or a Nation: +2 Power and +5 to all its defenses, Disasters included. Only the first copy linked to a Place counts.
power-satellite.flavor: Orbit hums quietly, watching the ground argue about whose flag that is.

flesh-eating-bacteria.rules: Disaster! Attacks to Destroy any Place, no action, not Instant: Power 20. Science Groups may help defend; CDC helps at triple Power. Success Devastates it; beating the roll by 8+ destroys it, and a Science action returns it to hand.
flesh-eating-bacteria.flavor: Hand sanitizer sold out within the hour; hand-wringing sold out shortly after.

slackfusion.rules: For the rest of the turn, Illuminati Action tokens may be given or traded in deals, Illuminati to Illuminati only.
slackfusion.flavor: Reaction achieved; containment remains theoretical, mostly.

luck-plane.rules: Right after any die roll: it becomes a 2. An attack too weak to roll still fails outright. Discard three other Plots to play this.
luck-plane.flavor: Turbulence is guaranteed; a safe landing is not.

the-world-ends-tomorrow-and-you-may-die.rules: Declared with an attack on a Group in the uncontrolled area (hand, in a mixed game): the attacker spends its token and must share an alignment with the target, or be Media. The attack succeeds at once; your turn ends.
the-world-ends-tomorrow-and-you-may-die.flavor: The end keeps a very flexible schedule.

take-the-money-and-run.rules: Zap. Requires an Illuminati action. Played on a rival Illuminati: no Group in that Power Structure may take over Criminal Groups. Stays until removed.
take-the-money-and-run.flavor: The getaway car is idling; the alibi was rehearsed last week.

yacatisma.rules: Not during an attack. Requires a SubGenius action. Discard two of a rival's hidden Plots, chosen at random.
yacatisma.flavor: Their exhaust alone reroutes rush hour traffic.

brushfire-war.rules: Zap! Requires an Illuminati action. Play on a rival Illuminati: no Group in their Power Structure may take over Peaceful Groups. Stays until removed; any player may spend an Illuminati action to strip every Zap from one player.
brushfire-war.flavor: Small skirmishes kept escalating just enough to justify the next budget request.
